constraints: If resFilename is an empty string, the standard Open File dialog box is presented for interactive selection.

If a resource file already open within the current 4D session is reopened, the existing reference number is returned instead of erroring (unlike Open document); attempting to open a resource file already open in another application raises an I/O error.

Each successful open (even of an already-open file) must still be matched by one CLOSE RESOURCE FILE call to actually close it; all opened resource files are auto-closed when quitting the application or opening another database.

sentinelValues.meaning: Presents the standard Open File dialog box for interactive selection instead of opening a named resource file.

params.name: fileType
params.description: macOS file type (4-character string) or Windows file extension (1-3 characters) used to filter the Open dialog; if omitted, all files are shown.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Opens the resource file named or pathed by resFilename (or presents the Open File dialog if resFilename is an empty string, filtered by fileType), returning its resource file reference number.
overloadMerges.note: Documented the resFilename empty-string sentinel (interactive dialog), which autoparse left as a bare Text param.
